caption: The video captures a low-angle sunset view over a calm body of water. A transparent crystal lens-ball rests motionless on a bed of wet, dark pebbles in the left foreground. The ball refracts an upside-down image of the horizon and a bright sliver of the sun, while its upper surface holds a steady dark reflection that does not shift across the excerpt. The sun sits just above a distant flat shoreline, throwing a vertical golden glitter-path across the water, and the sky glows warm orange-pink with thin clouds. Throughout the clip the framing stays fixed, so the visible motion lives entirely in the water. Small ripples travel across the surface, continuously breaking and re-forming the sun's shimmering column so its shape and brightness fluctuate frame to frame while its position remains the same. The sheen on the wet pebbles shifts subtly, and a thin film of water appears to creep and retreat over the stones to the right of the ball, changing how glossy that area looks. The crystal ball itself neither rolls nor translates, and the camera holds its viewpoint.
